Switch

Switch is a toggle control for binary on/off states. It provides a more intuitive UI than checkboxes for settings and preferences.

Basic Switch

Simple switch with label.

HTML
<div class="zak-form-check zak-switch-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="darkmode" class="zak-form-check-input zak-switch" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="darkmode">Dark Mode</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-check zak-switch-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="notifications" class="zak-form-check-input zak-switch">
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="notifications">Email Notifications</label>
</div>

Disabled Switch

Non-interactive disabled state.

HTML
<div class="zak-form-check zak-switch-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" class="zak-form-check-input zak-switch" checked disabled>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label">Enabled (disabled control)</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-check zak-switch-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" class="zak-form-check-input zak-switch" disabled>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label">Disabled switch</label>
</div>

Switch with Icons

Add icons to represent on/off states.

HTML
<div class="zak-form-check zak-switch-wrapper">
  <input type="checkbox" id="lights" class="zak-form-check-input zak-switch" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="lights">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2"/>
    </svg>
    Lights
  </label>
</div>

JS Toggle Demo

Interactive demo showing toggle state with JavaScript.

Status: OFF

JavaScript
document.getElementById('sw-demo').addEventListener('change', function() {
  document.getElementById('sw-demo-status').textContent = this.checked ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
});

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-switchBase switch toggle
.zak-switch-smSmall size
.zak-switch-lgLarge size
.zak-switch-primaryPrimary color
.zak-switch-successSuccess color
.zak-switch-dangerDanger color
.zak-switch-warningWarning color
.zak-switch-wrapperWrapper for switch + label

Accessibility

  • Use role="switch" on the input element.
  • Set aria-checked="true" or aria-checked="false" to indicate state.
  • Associate with a visible <label> via for/id.
  • Support keyboard interaction: Space to toggle.
  • Disabled switches should have aria-disabled="true".
